To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

multimedia 3-IPPC(n, M, q) codes can be characterized in terms of bipartite graphs and generalized packings, and that the size of such a code can be upper-bounded by the size of an optimal bipartite matching in the corresponding bipartite graph.
we introduce a new class of codes, multimedia IPP codes, which are a multimedia analogue of IPP codes, and that we characterize and construct optimal multimedia 3 IPP codes of length 3.
we have introduced a novel combinatorial concept called multimedia IPP codes and derived a tight upper bound and constructed infinite families of (optimal) multimedia IPP codes.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the construction of multimedia IPP codes, which is a fundamental problem in the context of multimedia fingerprinting, where multimedia fingerprinting codes are employed to trace pirates who have colluded in the distribution of pirated multimedia products.
the fundamental problem of identifying the parents of any sub-code of a multimedia IPP code, which is of great significance in multimedia fingerprinting.
the design of multimedia IPP codes for multimedia fingerprinting.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the size M of an optimal multimedia t-IPP codes of arbitrary length n and size q can be upper bounded by qn − 1, and the upper bound is tight when t = 3.
we have established a new framework to investigate codes with IPP in the multimedia scenario, and we have obtained several interesting results on multimedia IPP codes of length 3.
we have established the basic foundations of multimedia IPP codes, and that the study of multimedia IPP codes is a promising and interesting research topic.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have established an initial theory of multimedia IPP codes, which may serve as a basis for further research on this topic.
we have developed the foundations of the multimedia IPP theory and established the existence of multimedia IPP codes with large size.
we have introduced a new class of codes, multimedia IPP codes, and have characterized the optimal codes of the new class in the case of length 2.
The main takeaway from our work is that
multimedia fingerprinting codes with the identifiable descendant property are a new and promising tool to combat piracy of multimedia content.
the multimedia IPP codes are a powerful tool for the construction of multimedia fingerprinting codes.
the combinatorial structure of multimedia IPP codes is very rich and interesting.
